output.review_comment: Cannot approve without: (1) a PR description explaining what was broken and how the changes fix it, (2) verification that the new logic matches the function's docstring (the source of truth per the teammate's instructions), and (3) confirmation that tests pass. Additionally, the cap vs. minimum precedence change is concerning—the new logic could return fees exceeding the cap if MINIMUM_FEE_CENTS > cap, which may contradict the intended semantics. Please provide explicit docstring reference and clarify this logic.
